nailOracles.needle: Every actual posed hand skin/nail triangle against conservative circular handle frustum and40mm shaft cylinder; reported depth is the conservative frustum penetration, not an inferred marker-only gap.
nailOracles.self: Three-direction majority parity with unchanged50micrometre exclusion: exposed skin/nail pairs, and all rigid distal skin independently against actual palm.
nailOracles.patient: Unmodified production PatientClearance (including surface crossings) plus per-posed-mesh vertex oracle, before and after actual arm solve.
nailOracles.material: Actual native alias P/Q,parent,source skin barycentric and real nail vertex97 attachment, exact normal field and engagedWith roles.
nailOracles.bones: Actual local joint translations/scales strictly equal source; actual world segment distances and node quaternion norm error separately recorded.

numericBoneDiagnostic.explanation: Float32 animated node quaternions produce a few nanometres of world-distance arithmetic drift despite strictly identical local joint translations and scales. The new100nm diagnostic budget is distinct from unchanged25micrometre needle and50micrometre self/patient contracts. Actual nonzero drift is retained; it is never reported as zero.

sourceOnly120StateAttributionAudit.scope: Earlier04fb source-only diagnostic, explanatory provenance; not substituted for final1bb reports.

surfaceSupport54.scope: 36 palpate/stretch fixture cases visible; all 18 press cases retain explicit Move closer reach hiding in this fixed low-back practitioner stance. This is not a claim that pressing is reachable here. All 54 geometric poses are audited separately from visibility.

additionalLocalDiagnostics.note: These source-pinned local measurements supplement the committed automated tests. They do not establish every patient/pose combination.

freeRigDiagnostic.scope: Four-finger deformation inspection with an independent named thumb pose. The third row reads the authored closed-fist M/R/L curled table; the index 52/72/42-degree example is an independent rig probe, not the operator's actual working index. Actual thumb bearings and source-relative rotations are reported separately. Runtime needle-grip solutions require their own UI checks. These are not neutral/comfort or clinical ROM measurements.
freeRigDiagnostic.method: Actual GLB accessors and standard LBS; fixed-length anatomical hinges in palm_frame; no clip interpolation, no mesh modifiers
freeRigDiagnostic.limitations: The independent free-hand probes can retain skin-boundary crossings/contacts; see the actual affected surfaces, poses, counts and intersection points. Palm-enclosed intersections are reported separately using the actual posed palm union and three-direction parity. This diagnostic is not evidence of a natural collision-free grip; public runtime grip poses are verified separately.

publicUi.scope: Real production UI screenshots; retained first-nine and post-walk optional/nail/phase groups have explicitly different public stance baselines when resumed. Free-finger styles and handedness use public controls; no actor hiding, skin overrides or clinical needle-path changes.

stageCheck.method: Fresh StageBundle from current sources equals real8795HTTP response bytes

retainedComparison.scope: The first nine successful real UI frames are retained from the initial 1bb/5809 comparison run before the optional tripod reach failure. Their image hashes, parameters and visible states are preserved. The original failure writer did not serialize its browser response bodies/hashes; this group has initial matching served-product/stage checks and the explicitly frozen source checkpoint, rather than a claimed retained per-response fingerprint.

intentionalSetupMove.note: One accepted public move in the synthetic encounter before the current capture group. Feet and record version remain fixed during subsequent previews.

previewIsolation.scope: Current optional/nail/phase group after one recorded public setup walk; the retained first nine are the separate pre-walk group at65/63. Each captured motion keeps its own floor anchor and clinical record fixed.

publicUi.visibilityInterpretation: Contact counters inspect selected points, not the entire unoccluded hand. Actual sleeves, tie and self-occlusion remain visible in the images.

media.scope: Actual source GLB and real public-UI PNGs. Current hero is an unmodified duplicate of the current-source engaged raw frame. Retained nine-image comparison has its own older source/stance provenance; no invented per-response hashes. Composite strips use only uniform resize and plain tiling of real raw frames.

limitations.scope: Avatar cuff presentation, not a clinical wrist angle
limitations.description: The figure rig applies an authored forearm-roll cap of 85 degrees. Its target dorsal projection can remain unmatched; this is not a measurement of tissue twisting or full 3D wrist-angle error. Exact cuff alignment is not a passing criterion of the above contact/clearance tests.

limitations: Stylized procedural palm/finger surfaces and cuff/seam detail remain visible; the supplied photographs are not redistributed.
The free-rig inspection poses are authored deformation probes, not neutral/comfort or clinical ROM measurements.
Target-GPU real-time performance and paid live GPT/MiniMax calls were not exercised.
Nine retained ordinary/bimanual comparison images use the explicitly identified 1bb asset and cart stance. The current primary, optional/nail/phases and diagnostic grid use the final 8e asset.
